items.t: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Gets A Fresh AI Signal From A Key Platform Partner
items.sum: On Nvidia's latest earnings call in November 2026, management highlighted Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) as a key AI partner. Nvidia stressed its commitment to an open AI model ecosystem and cited Palantir's use of specialized open models on its platform. The remarks came as Nvidia goes through leadership changes, which puts fresh focus on which software and security partners it prioritizes
